title: Horizon, Null-Orbit, and Photon-Sphere Phase Structures in Logarithmic Nonlinear Electrodynamics
summary: We investigate static, charged, asymptotically flat black holes in logarithmic nonlinear electrodynamics (LNED) within the $(Q,ε)$ parameter space. We distinguish three phase structures: the horizon geometry, the background circular null orbits, and the circular photon orbits of the effective optical geometry. All share a zero-radius boundary $Q_{nc}(ε;M)=γM^{2/3}ε^{1/6}$, but possess distinct critical structures: the extremal curve $Q_{ext}(ε;M)$ and the background merger curve $Q_{m}(ε;M)$ both terminate at the bifurcation point $(Q_{b},ε_{b})$, located at $r=0$.
